description: This Java source file defines the BluetoothChecker class, which extends JobBase. It checks whether Bluetooth is enabled on the device, primarily used during device boot to ensure Bluetooth is active before proceeding. The class interacts with Android's BluetoothAdapter and PackageManager to determine Bluetooth status and features.

classes.name: BluetoothChecker
classes.description: A class that checks if Bluetooth is enabled on the device, used during startup to verify Bluetooth status.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the BluetoothChecker, checking if the device has Bluetooth feature.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the check to see if Bluetooth is enabled; returns a delay if not enabled.

methods.description: Handles failure scenarios by setting the internal future with an exception.

methods.description: Returns a GceFuture<Boolean> indicating whether Bluetooth is enabled.
